intro.text: Collab Desktop 2.4.1 lets you filter History by Frame and keeps the Google Drive connector signed in after a restart.

entries.title: Filter History by Frame
entries.body: The History search bar now has a **Frame** filter. Choose a Frame to see only the conversations that used it. The list shows the Frames installed in your current Hubspace.

claims.text: History search has a Frame filter that shows only conversations that used the chosen Frame.
claims.evidence_quote: This adds a **Frame** filter to the History search bar: choosing a Frame shows only conversations that used it.

claims.text: The filter lists the Frames installed in the current Hubspace.
claims.evidence_quote: The filter list shows Frames installed in the current Hubspace.

entries.title: Google Drive stays connected after restart
entries.body: The Google Drive connector no longer shows **Reconnect** after Collab restarts while your sign-in is still valid.

claims.text: Before the fix, Google Drive showed Reconnect after a restart even though the sign-in was still valid.
claims.evidence_quote: After a restart the Google Drive connector showed **Reconnect** even though the token was still valid.

claims.text: The connector now stays signed in after Collab restarts.
claims.evidence_quote: so it stays signed in after Collab restarts

excluded.note: Build runner change with no product code changes.

gaps.detail: The Google Drive fix was tested on macOS and Windows only. Confirm Linux before the notes say it applies on every platform.
